en: GSC jumped on visibility: impressions 1,032→1,189, queries-with-impressions 92→105, clicks 67→68. But CTR fell 6.5%→5.7% and average position slipped 24.1→26.2 — the site now surfaces for more queries at lower ranks, the expected shape of non-brand coverage expanding. GSC window shifted to 5 Jul→1 Aug.

GA4 window 6 Jul→2 Aug: sessions 405→381, engaged sessions 270→256, key events 42→38, total events 3,461→3,331 — down because high early-period days rolled out of the trailing window. Session quality still improved: engagement rate 66.7%→67.2%, avg engagement time 1m49s→1m56s.
AI assistant channel unchanged: 2 sessions from chatgpt.com / ai-assistant (0.52% of total), 50% engagement, 7 seconds, 0 key events — re-verified in the Session source / medium report.

Ahrefs grew steadily: referring domains 341→352 (all-time 367), backlinks 346→357 (all-time 382), Health Score held at 100 (0 errors across 14 crawled internal URLs), organic keywords/traffic still 0.

AI citations rose sharply 14→19: ChatGPT 6→11 (3 cited pages), Copilot held at 8 (2 pages). AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Perplexity remain 0; Grok is paused by Ahrefs so it is recorded as null, not 0.

AI Visibility held at 16/100: still 2/6 platforms present. Citations grew but not enough to move a dimension band. Brand Radar and the technical-readiness signals were NOT re-read today — they carry forward from the last full audit.
